news.title: Justin Bieber Undies On Stage -- Good Genes or Good Docs?! - TMZ

weekly_forecast: Justin Bieber's stage antics will inspire a wave of 'strategic wardrobe malfunctions' from influencers desperate for attention. A TikTok trend emerges where people 'accidentally' rip their pants while lip-syncing to 'Baby.' Meanwhile, TMZ hires a team of forensic fabric analysts to determine if the undies were vintage or just poorly stitched. The week culminates in a conspiracy theory that the whole thing was a distraction from aliens.
